eb58 (Model classes: trivial/standard/frontier) = PASS, 0 blocking, 4 advisory. SIGNED + CERTIFIED at 18ecd9709; close running. All SIX children closed: 172e, 7761, cb6f, cc33, d23e, f844.

THE UNSCOPED-ATTESTATION LESSON, APPLIED FORWARD RATHER THAN REDISCOVERED. eb58's attestation was stale-head with ZERO file_impact entries — reviewing it in that state would have minted ANOTHER unscoped attestation that dies on the very next commit, which is exactly the trap 9227 sat in for days. So I set file_impact FIRST (22 entries), then reviewed ONCE.

AND I BUILT THAT SCOPE FROM EVIDENCE, NOT MEMORY — worth recording as a reusable technique. The union of the children's OWN file_impact covered only d23e and 7761; the other four (172e, cb6f, cc33, f844) closed before that discipline existed and declared nothing. So I recovered their real footprint from git: `git log --grep="rebar-ticket: <id>" origin/main..HEAD` per child, then `git show --stat`. That surfaced files I would NOT have listed from recall — _config_sources.py and config.py (cb6f), providers.py and runner.py (cc33), plan_review/__init__.py and completion.py (172e). Recall would have produced a plausible, incomplete scope, and an incomplete scope is worse than none because it looks authoritative.

CHECKED FORWARD so this cannot recur: every remaining ticket already has file_impact — 0d76=2, eb6e=4, 8625=3, 3768=5, 5e75=3, epic 061c=4. Only the two EPICS had the gap, which fits: they were opened before the discipline and epics accumulate scope from children rather than declaring their own.

PARALLELISM, deliberately: 8625 (S9, ADR + docs for the provider seam) has deps=0 but was UNSIGNED, so it needed a plan review before it could be claimed. That review is now running ALONGSIDE eb58's close. This does NOT violate the serialise-plan-reviews rule — that rule exists because two concurrent PLAN reviews once produced findings against superseded ticket text. A close-gate COMPLETION VERIFIER and a plan review on a DIFFERENT ticket touch different material and cannot contend that way.

STATE: closed = 7761, 172e, 343b, 7cbe, b00f, d8ef, b300, b5fe, d23e, epic 9227; eb58 closing. Remaining: 0d76 (S6), eb6e (S8), 8625 (S9) -> 3768 -> 5e75 -> epic 061c -> LAND THE STACK. 20 Gerrit changes all LLM-Review +1 and SUBMITTABLE; nothing submitted, per standing instruction.
